description: Returns the Market Eyes Live MELANY rating for one U.S.-listed stock or ETF: a conviction tier (weakest to strongest: Unfavorable, Hold, Favorable, Highest Conviction; names without mature fundamentals carry Promising, Very Promising, Rising Star, Runner! or Catalyst Watch instead; ETFs and REITs use the same ladder), a 0 to 100 composite score, eight factor scores (valuation, quality, momentum, earnings, sentiment, catalyst, risk-adjusted, macro fit), flagged risks, theme context and the as-of date. Use this when the user asks how Market Eyes Live rates a U.S. ticker or wants a factor breakdown of one, for example 'what is the Market Eyes Live rating on AAPL' or 'how does NVDA score on valuation and momentum'. Do not use for real-time or intraday quotes, price history, options, order books, crypto, futures, non-U.S. listings, or a personal recommendation; tickers outside U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs return a not-covered message. Limitations: the daily-refreshed set answers instantly; other covered tickers are scored live at a lower hourly limit; ratings are algorithmic, dated by as_of, and can lag news; it does not return entry zones, alert levels or position sizing (when Market Eyes Live has a trade plan for the ticker, the trade_plan field says so; the plan values are part of a Market Eyes Live subscription). Methodology and the graded public record: https://marketeyeslive.com/how-melany-is-tested.html. Research data, not financial advice; this tool is read-only and never places trades.

symbol.description: U.S. ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, AAPL, VOO

name: get_stock_rating

outputSchema.description: MELANY rating for the ticker. Present on a successful rating; omitted for not-covered, not-found or rate-limited results, which return an explanatory text message instead.

freshness.description: present only when scored live on demand

methodology.description: how the ratings are built and graded

rating_page.description: the public rating page for this ticker

rating_tier.description: Conviction tier. Mature ladder, weakest to strongest: Unfavorable, Hold, Favorable, Highest Conviction. Favorable and Highest Conviction are both favorable reads; Highest Conviction is a composite of 69 or above (for a stock, a small hysteresis can hold a borderline label steady between refreshes; a fund or REIT word follows its label in the app, which has none). Names the mature ladder does not cover carry their own label: Promising, then Very Promising, then Rising Star for names without mature fundamentals, Runner! for a momentum surge, Catalyst Watch for a news-driven gap up on volume. ETFs and REITs use the same mature ladder, chosen by the tone of the fund's own label in the app (a favorable fund label reads Favorable or Highest Conviction, a cautious or neutral one Hold, a negative one Unfavorable); a leveraged or inverse fund never reads above Hold. These nine words are the complete set; null when no tier applies.

trade_plan.description: Present only when Market Eyes Live has a trade plan for this ticker (an entry zone, an alert level and position sizing). The plan values are never included here; they are part of a Market Eyes Live subscription.

described_on.description: the rating page, present when that page describes the plan

included.description: always false: the plan values are not part of this data
